title: Career Roadmap · Painter & Decorator
summary: A Painter & Decorator prepares surfaces and applies paint, coatings, wallpaper and decorative finishes to protect and improve residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Surface preparation • Putty and sanding • Priming • Painting • Wallpaper • Decorative finishes • Colour matching • Quality checks.

blocks.text: DGT lists Painter (General) as a two-year CTS trade with Class 8 entry, Domestic Painter as a one-year trade with Class 10 entry, and Industrial Painter as a one-year trade with Class 10 entry. Verify current availability through DGT and the NCVT MIS ITI search.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Surface types, tools, safety, measuring and basic colour theory.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Application
blocks.text: Cleaning, scraping, sanding, putty, priming, brush and roller techniques.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Spray painting, decorative textures, wallpaper, wood finishes and protective coatings.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Practical portfolio, material estimation, client communication and supervised site experience.

blocks.text: Prepare and paint a sample wall panel • Create two decorative texture samples • Refinish a wooden stool • Produce a colour-and-finish sample board.
